title: 第272章 拉福尔卡下场
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

福尔卡盯着那个文件袋。

理智告诉他不要碰，但双腿却像灌了铅一样挪不动步。

“不止一次军功？你这个话到底是什么意思。”

福尔卡警惕地问。

张剑双手撑在桌面上，身体前倾，直视着福尔卡的眼睛。

“雅利安确实死了。”

“但他死有余辜。”

“因为他不仅是黑狼帮的后台，他还是在为土耳其人做事儿。”

福尔卡愣住了，半张着嘴巴。

“土耳其人？”

“对。”

张剑点点头。

“雅利安利用海关缉私局局长的职务之便，长期为土耳其第2集团军的卡西姆将军提供走私通道。”

“这批走私的货物，全都是dU品、军用装备等。”

“而且，卡西姆还派了一名代号‘鬣狗’的精锐雇佣兵潜入巴扎尔甘，雅利安就是他的接头人。”

张剑每说一句话，福尔卡的眼睛就睁大一分。

直到最后，福尔卡整个人已经彻底呆住了。

“你……你说真的？”

张剑指了指桌上的文件袋。

“雅利安临死前交代得很清楚。”

“这里面有他的录音和供词，还有一些从保险柜里拿出来的东西，虽然不是那么全，但也都在里面了。”

“包括他利用职务之便，绕过你们边防营的防区，私自放土耳其军火入境的详细路线。”

“少校，你想想。”

“一个边境海关的局长，勾结敌国将领，走私军火。”

“这案子要是破了，算谁的功劳？”

福尔卡的心跳开始加速。

他是个军人，对军功有着本能的渴望。

如果张剑说的是真的，这绝对是一个能让他直接晋升中校甚至上校的惊天大功！

但福尔卡也不傻，他盯着张剑。。

“既然有这么大的功劳，你为什么不自己交给艾哈里德将军？”

“偏偏要给我？”

张剑笑了笑，重新坐回沙发上。

“因为我只是个商人。”

“我不想卷入你们的相互调查之中。”

“而且……”

张剑停顿了一下，眼神变得有些耐人寻味。

“鬣狗已经被我的人干掉了。”

“卡西姆那边很快就会发现他们失联。”

“接下来，土耳其人肯定会有所动作。”

“我需要边防营帮我挡住外面的麻烦。”

“这功劳，就当是我交的保护费了。”

福尔卡看着桌上的文件袋，心里犹如猫抓一般。

他知道，张剑这是在逼他站队。

Page (1/3)

Fulka stared at the portfolio.

Reason told him not to touch, but his legs felt like they were filled with lead and couldn't move.

"More than one military exploit? What do you mean by that?"

Fulka asked warily.

Zhang Jian put his hands on the table, leaned forward, and looked directly into Fulka's eyes.

"Aryan is indeed dead."

"But he deserved his death."

"Because he is not only the backend of the Black Wolf Gang, he is also doing things for the Turks."

Fulka was stunned, his mouth half open.

"Turks?"

"Yes."

Zhang Jian nodded.

"Aryan took advantage of his position as director of the Customs Anti-Smuggling Bureau to provide smuggling channels for General Qasim of the Turkish Second Army for a long time."

"This batch of smuggled goods are all drugs, military equipment, etc."

"Moreover, Qasim also sent an elite mercenary code-named 'Hyena' to infiltrate Bazargan, and Aryan was his contact person."

Every time Zhang Jian said a word, Fulka's eyes widened.

Until the end, Fulka was completely stunned.

"You...are you serious?"

Zhang Jian pointed to the document bag on the table.

"Aryan made a very clear statement before he died."

"There are his recordings and confessions, as well as some things taken out of the safe. Although not all of them, they are all in there."

"Including the detailed route in which he took advantage of his position to bypass the defense area of your border guard camp and secretly release Turkish arms into the country."

"Major, think about it."

"A director of border customs colluded with enemy generals to smuggle arms."

"If this case is solved, who gets the credit?"

Fulka's heart began to beat faster.

He is a soldier and has an instinctive desire for military glory.

If what Zhang Jian said is true, this is definitely a great achievement that will allow him to be directly promoted to lieutenant colonel or even colonel!

But Fulka wasn't stupid either, he stared at Zhang Jian..

"Since you have such great merit, why don't you hand it over to General Alharid yourself?"

"You want to give it to me?"

Zhang Jian smiled and sat back on the sofa.

"Because I'm just a businessman."

"I don't want to get involved in your mutual investigations."

"And..."

Zhang Jian paused for a moment, his eyes becoming a little intriguing.

"The hyena has been killed by my men."

"Qasim's side will soon discover that they have lost contact."

"Next, the Turks will definitely make some moves."

"I need the border camp to help me keep out the trouble outside."

"This credit should be regarded as the protection fee I paid."

Fulka looked at the file bag on the table, feeling as if a cat was scratching his head.

He knew that Zhang Jian was forcing him to take sides.
